notes.title: Interest Poll Results!
notes.content:
We’ve got the numbers in and have a pretty clear idea of what we need to do next! These charts are broken down into Patron, Public and Total results. Keep in mind that the percentages are approximate since I didn't want to get anal with the decimals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112066/08f367a0d9f7840cdef38d05210409be783295e9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112066/377eea54885754aa1d7034f2b3be03940f946256.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112066/c844fa6290f51b675181f83f2cfe01a07a0f5478.png[/img]

The patron results skew towards resuming work on Project Cappuccino 2, while the public one leans heavier into DLC for Milking Mira. While we expected some of this, we didn’t think that some of the other projects would get that much interest this early on. The good thing is that this aligns with what we intended to do in the first place.

Our plans at the moment are to begin work on Milking Sophie DLC while restoring Project Cappuccino 2 from a backup. Project Cappuccino 2 needs some streamlining and replanning so that we can avoid getting stuck working on it for an eternity, so I'll be spending time doing that. As for Milking Colette, that one is on the shelf until we gauge how Milking Sophie performs.

We may return to the 3 months on one project and 3 months on another schedule that we briefly did during the second half of 2024.

Thanks for participating and we hope you guys are hyped!

-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Project Cappuccino - v1.25.3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
This may come as a surprise but we’ve released an optimization patch for Project Cappuccino! Originally, we developed this as our first project with little experience, but have gained considerable knowledge since its release and used an opportunity we had to make some fixes to the game. Unfortunately, some things like adding more save slots would require major reworks since we didn’t know better at the time and we risk breaking saves. (So that stuff will need to wait for an eventual remaster!)

However, there’s been massive optimization fixes done and the game is smoother to play now. If you run into any bugs, please don’t hesitate to let us know and we’ll do our best to solve them.

[b]Here’s what’s changed.[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized load times between large scenes such as the Cafe Lobby. Players should see around 20-30% faster loading between scenes.
[*] Optimized Compression of Some Sprites: This should also contribute to loading times and the game’s file size.
[*] Cleaned up unnecessary code
[*] Added new SFX to secret Sophie route
[*] Grammar Fixes
[*] Embedded Discord Link in Game: Come join us for news on all things Tentakero.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and be sure to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887580/Project_Cappuccino_2_The_Succubus_Throne/]Project Cappuccino 2![/url]
-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Project Cappuccino 2 - Public Reveal!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=NSQt-Kuxy4s;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been working on Project Cappuccino 2 for a little while now, and it's time to pull the covers off to the public.

[b]The Story[/b]

Project Cappuccino 2 will feature 4 new main characters and will revolve around the mess that Mira left behind in the underworld by escaping to earth. The underworld is in the process of selecting a new Succubus Queen, and things are about to get heated! Players take the role of a Succubus/Incubus/Concubus in training and will be tasked with making sure that their succubus becomes the next Queen!

[b]THE NEW CAST[/b]

[b]ROSARIA - EX-SUCCUBUS QUEEN[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36040950/7300ac2c9d71d3f2808b46f127f9f1ffa565a1ed.png[/img]

Ex-Succubus Queen from the Domain of Conjuration that has lost her position of power due to Mira. Rosaria is being given a chance to prove herself and maintain control of the throne. Unfortunately, she no longer has the influence and power that she had during her reign, so many tend to treat her like a normal demon. The many years spent as queen allowed her to become a well-rounded succubus, having experience in all sorts of debauchery. In a sense, she was a kind and caring queen. Maybe a little too kind for her own good.

[b]MANA - LADY OF VICES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36040950/92202167cc80775b60bb1bf7d2dbb6ea832ea618.png[/img]

A sinister succubus from the Domain of Blight, known as the Lady of Vices. Mana can be cold and ruthless, but she enjoys the good life and mortal pleasures. Over time, she has learned to specialize in curses and poisons. Rumor has it that she used nefarious methods to become the #1 succubus in her domain, making a vast number of enemies in the process. Realistically, she will rule with an uncaring precision if she were to become the next Succubus Queen.

[b]YANI - THE BEAST OF MEROTH[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36040950/cb35e5cf4300f1400ccbb577ca1ac776a0f58ded.png[/img]

Yani is a brute of a succubus that hails from the Domain of Power. She can be playful at times but is a hazard to be around. Prior to entering the tournament for the Succubus Throne, she had been imprisoned at the Burning Pit, a confinement for extremely dangerous demons. Her release from the Burning Pit came with an agreement. Win the tournament and become the next Succubus Queen, or return to the prison, permanently.

[b]CHARLOTTE - PRINCESS OF DEATH[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36040950/a0d27f5266717fecd41f171c51b24de0fa0df551.png[/img]

Heir to the throne of the Domain of Life and Death. Charlotte is a rare crossbreed demon that came to be when a romance sparked between the Succubus Queen that preceded Rosaria, and the dark one known as the Hand of Death. Seeing as she has both succubus blood and the blood of a demon lord, she believes that it’s her right to secure the title of Succubus Queen. Her personality has been known to shift in dangerous ways, indicated by the flame on her tail.

-------------------------

More info on the game itself will continue to become available as development continues!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Will the original cast be in this game?[/b]

Yes! We intend for the original cast to show up through a parallel story that focuses on what they’ve been up to in the past 2 years. Chapters of the original cast’s route will unlock as you complete the new character’s routes.

[b]How long is the game going to be?[/b]

The story will be AT LEAST as long as Project Cappuccino, but we are aiming for 4-8 hours of story game play. Each new character will have their own route, and a fifth story route will unlock when completing all 4 of them. Aside from this, we’re planning the Cafe Saga that will focus on the original girls and what they've been up to in the past 2 years.

[b]Can we still pick our Skin Tone & Gender?[/b]

Yes. We may also add some unnatural demon skin tones to the mix too but we’ll see. We’re also toying with the idea of letting players pick parts of their body like tongue shape, breast size, etc.

[b]What’s the Gameplay like?[/b]

We’re trying not to deviate too much from Project Cappuccino in this one, so the game will be a mix of visual novel with mini game aspects. Interactive NSFW scenes will be similar to Cappuccino’s “rooms”, but with more variety between them. Honestly, we need to make a whole post about game mechanics that we have planned.

[b]Will there be new kinks/fetish content?[/b]

Yes! That’s part of the reason why we had that fetish poll recently. We want to make this one everything that Project Cappuccino was and more, so we will be ramping up the NSFW content to include a larger variety of things. Since this game takes place in literal hell, we do need to warn that some content and themes may be darker/lewder than in Project Cappuccino. We also plan to use the fantasy element to its full potential since we’re not bound by earth rules here and we can stretch reality. (If we want magic and monsters, we got magic and monsters.)

[b]Why the new cast?[/b]

We intend to bring the two groups together in the future in a third game, and it’s necessary to establish who they are first. As well as flesh out the world’s lore that was lightly touched on in PC1. Things like the tomes, underworld regions, why Mira is worried about being hunted down, etc.

These new characters are intended to be hard counters to the main girl’s personalities.

Rosaria -> Mira: Both pompous and with huge conflicting egos.

Mana -> Colette: Both commanding and sharp. Mana is a bit lazier at times and rough around the edges, which would irk Colette.

Yani -> Sophie: Yani is what you get when you take Sophie’s chaotic energy and ramp it up by 1000%. Yani would eat mud and destroy a cafe while Sophie panics in the background.

Charlotte -> Cerise: Charlotte is the ultimate in spoiled royalty and would give Cerise a bit of a wakeup call when it comes to her panicked and cry baby personality.

[b]When does this game take place?[/b]

Since time does not flow at the same rate as on earth, this game starts around 2 earth years after the events of Project Cappuccino. In demon time, it’s been about a month or two.

[b]When can we play it?[/b]

We’re aiming to have a public playable build around Summer this year. Patrons can already try out an early prototype version. We’ll keep news about this game pouring until then.

Thanks for reading!

-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Curious about what Tentakero has been working on?
notes.content:
It's time to talk a little more about what's been going on behind the scenes at Tentakero HQ!

Ever since development on Project Cappuccino wrapped up in Q1 2020, we've been hard at work trying out new things for our next game. Various prototypes and sweat later, we're finally getting somewhere!

The next game in our pipeline is Crystal Road - Vale of Memories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36040950/f22d4767a942c4e562d2ece5104fa4c1664e7d2a.png[/img]

Crystal Road is a Farming/Life Sim set in a strange world, shrouded in a dense fog. Begin your new life as you unravel the mystery of the Crystal Road. Befriend a growing cast of characters and get to know them as you chat with them, explore their quests and even have sex with them. Will you be able to turn the barren land into a thriving community?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36040950/23626205ec39a55666947dbe6028441da5f5dd9f.png[/img]

There is still a TON of work to do on this game and it's nowhere near ready for a release here on Steam, or even an Early Access release. However, we are firm believers that if we engage players from early on in development, we'll get better quality feedback along the way.

notes.title: Small Announcement Regarding Region Locking and the Sweets Avatar Frame
notes.content:
We wanted to quickly mention some things regarding Project Cappuccino on Steam.

[b]Region Restrictions Lifted[/b]
Per popular request, region locking has been lifted from some countries, since we were a bit too heavy-handed at first. We were trying to err on the side of caution. In any case, please be aware of your local laws when accessing adult content.

[b]Resting Bean Desserts Avatar Frame has been resized![/b]
The "Resting Bean Desserts" avatar frame now fits better around the steam avatar size and no longer has empty space. Those that have already picked this frame up from the points shop should not have to repurchase it again. We decided to leave the "Succubus Tail" one as is since that one was intended to crop a little bit due to its circular shape. Additionally, trying to fit it in the boundaries just didn't work well with that particular frame when it came to redrawing it.

Lastly, we are aware that some players in China are unable to use the animated "Cappuccino Girls" avatar without getting their profiles suspended. Unfortunately, we have not been able to find a solution to this yet. Please attempt to contact Steam support directly since we have not had reports of the avatar causing issues in other regions.

Thanks for playing Project Cappuccino!
-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.25.2 - Achievement & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Some of you may have noticed that there have been some updates pushed out to Project Cappuccino recently. We’ve been dealing with some backend bugs and making some minor adjustments. Here’s what’s changed.

[list]
[*] [b]Resolved an Issue with Steam Achievements being broken due to an appID mismatch.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed Censorship Mistake:[/b] There was a mixup in the version intended for Japan and we accidentally left in a censor in the cut in camera of the Inn Room encounter.
[*] [b]Fixed Room 3 Colette Bug:[/b] Vag Toys were cropping improperly due to a sprite mask.
[*] [b]Fixed Request Bubble Bug:[/b] Tracked down a rare bug that was being triggered by request bubbles activating endlessly. It is our suspicion that this bug is what was causing the game to crash at times on certain Mac computers. We’re not 100% sure if it’s solved the mac crashing but we’ll continue to monitor the situation.
[*] [b]Modified Request Bubble Frequency:[/b] Max spawn time for a request bubble has been reduced but bubbles now become less frequent if you’re already using some of the girls requested toys.
[/list]

We're hard at work on a new title and will likely be posting about it here when we have more info to share!

Thanks for playing,
Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Steam cards are live!
notes.content:
That's right! Project Cappuccino now has Steam cards for you to collect! 

There are a total of 8 cards, 4 backgrounds and 5 emoji's out in the wild that can be displayed on your Steam profiles. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: The Lucretia Update is Here!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/231010975497715712/670334485023293450/LucretiaUpdate_Header_Capsule.png[/img]

Lucretia can now be unlocked by purchasing all toys in story mode. If you already have an existing save file with everything purchased, simply head into the shop and it will trigger the special unlock dialogue! From there, she’ll become accessible in Free Play mode permanently. (Or until you delete all your save data.)

[b]Along with this, we’ve also fixed a few bugs:[/b]
-Fixed Text Error in Chapter 2: Following Colette into the woods had a line that made it sound as if Sophie was there too.
-Fixed Colette Work Assignment Bug: Colette had a wire crossed that was causing the stress meter to overflow during work assignment. Issue was only happening when assigning specific amounts of work.
-Fixed Mira Undressing System Bug: Removing her accessories was not properly disabling other buttons and would allow spam clicking of other clothing parts.
-Fixed Cerise Request Bubble Bug: The Bunny was counting as the Clothing pins whenever she requested that particular toy.
-Fixed Mira Request Bubble Bug: Some of Mira’s bubbles were not disappearing when the requested toy was used.

We hope you guys enjoy Lucretia and thank you for playing Project Cappuccino!
-Vanis & Dokucchi

notes.title: Free Update Coming to Project Cappuccino!
notes.content:
Hello Steam and all who inhabit it! We want to start off our first announcement by thanking you for playing Project Cappuccino! Our dev team is composed of two people and we really bust our asses working on this game. Seeing people enjoying it is incredible and we can’t thank you enough!

[b]We are aware of some bugs and are working on them![/b]
Some of our players have informed us of some issues that they've run into. The biggest one being a Colette bug that causes her route to supersede others if her standing is low enough. (Under -15 to -20 or so)

The second bug is more of a minor oversight! There’s an achievement that requires finding 3 gnomes hidden in the game’s backgrounds but we accidentally added a 4th gnome at some point in development and forgot about it completely! He’s sitting on the bottom left shelf of Sweet Seductions and isn’t clickable, so there are 3 others hidden out there.

We’re working to get these bugs patched ASAP and will roll out a patch as soon as it’s been taken care of. Thank you for your patience in that regard!

[b]Upcoming Free Lucretia Patch to all owners of the game[/b]
Those of you that have been following us for a while are probably aware of this, but we’ve got some news for new players!

Late into development, we managed to hit a stretch goal of adding Lucretia to Free Play mode. She will be coming to all owners of the game as a Free Update in the next couple of months. We aim to have her available in all 3 rooms, including the Inn Room’s undressing system.

Along with this, there is also some sprite artwork improvements that will be made. The girls expressions will have alternate poses to go with them, that way it’s not just the faces that change.

We hope you guys are as excited for the update as we are, and thank you for the successful launch!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EJgb7UbXYAABflX?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

We'll keep you guys informed if there are any change in plans!
-Vanis & Dokucchi
